propositions: gateway/* providers (gateway/anthropic, gateway/bedrock, gateway/google-cloud, gateway/groq, gateway/openai) are incorrectly stamped tier=first_class when no base_url is configured, misrepresenting that the request traversed an opaque intermediary that can rewrite it.
The tier classification derives from base_url presence alone, but gateway providers should always be classified as best_effort because they are intermediaries regardless of base_url configuration.
A signed verdict with tier=first_class stamped on a gateway-routed run creates false trust in provenance attestation, violating the two-tier design's contract with consumers.
Direct providers with no base_url must continue to stamp tier=first_class to avoid collateral damage; only gateway/* providers trigger best_effort classification.
endpoint_host remains None for gateway providers unless an actual base_url was configured, to report only values that were explicitly set rather than deriving hostnames from provider names.
